dataset.label: downloaded historical
dataset.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance 1.7.0 — daily adjusted close, NSE (.NS) tickers
dataset.survivorship_note: Universe is the NIFTY 50 membership as of 2026-10-08, applied to earlier periods. Stocks that left the index are absent and recent entrants are included before they joined, so historical (including held-out) performance is subject to survivorship bias.
dataset.universe_source: NSE Indices official NIFTY 50 constituent list (ind_nifty50list.csv)
dataset.missing_data_policy: Prices stored as received; no back-filling with later data. At estimation time gaps are forward-filled from the last past observation for at most 5 trading days. Assets without a price within 5 trading days of the training start, or with < 95 % training coverage, are dropped with an explicit issue. Held-out metrics use buy-and-hold from the last close before the segment.
issues: ETERNAL: history starts 2021-07-23 (later than dataset start 2019-01-01)
INDIGO: 1 interior missing price(s) (forward-filled up to 5 days at estimation)
JIOFIN: history starts 2023-08-21 (later than dataset start 2019-01-01)
MAXHEALTH: history starts 2020-08-21 (later than dataset start 2019-01-01)

selection_rule: Configuration (depth, optimizer, init, universe size) with the highest mean approximation ratio on the TRAINING objective across seeds (1 = exact optimum, 0 = worst feasible portfolio; a seed without a feasible sample counts as 0; compared to 9 decimals); ties -> higher mean final-batch feasible probability, then fewer mean circuit evaluations (optimisation + warm-start preparation), then lower depth. Every criterion is deterministic for fixed seeds (wall time is not used). Validation Sharpe is reported only; test data is never used.

noise_comparison.noise_model_summary: FakeTorino (qiskit-ibm-runtime snapshot) NoiseModel.from_backend restricted to 8 active physical qubits [73, 80, 81, 82, 83, 92, 98, 99]: 46 local gate errors, 8 readout errors; basis ['cz', 'delay', 'for_loop', 'id', 'if_else', 'measure', 'reset', 'rz', 'switch_case', 'sx', 'x']
noise_comparison.parameters_source: optimal parameters of the noise-free optimisation (fixed, not re-optimised under noise)

summary.method: same trained parameters, same shots and simulator seed in each paired trial; delta = noisy - ideal per trial; std = sample std over trials (ddof=1)
